---
title: "PipseqLymphoidcellsSubcluster_V0822"
author: "Xin Wang"
date: "2025-11-13"
description: This script is to analyze the lymphoid cdells, including T, NK, B, ILC cell Analysis
We have the preclustered immune cells object that have annotated with NK cell, B cell, and T cells
  - 1. Selection of lymphoid cells, 
  - 2. Basical statistics of different cell types
  - 2. Annotation of subclusters using the candidate markers
  - 3. Psudotime of Tcell
  - 4. Progeny analyses
  - 5. Functional enrichment
output: html_document
---

# ######################################################################################
# 1. Generate the subcluster of Lymphoid cells, including the T cell, B cell and NK cells
# ######################################################################################

# 1.1. Select the Lymphoid cells, including the T cell, B cell and NK cells, we applied the SCTtransform, RunPCA, RunUMAP, FindNeighbors and FindClusters.
```{r}
setwd(Outdir)
# Read the preclustered immune cells object
Indir <-
  "/Users/XXW004/Documents/Projects/RuizRosado/PIPseq/Results/Evaluation_V022723/CellEvaluation_Subclustering_V0803/SortedImmune_Clusters/"
scrna <- readRDS(file = paste0(Indir, "reclustered_cells_2.rds"))
scrna@meta.data %>% head()
Idents(scrna) = "RNA_snn_res.0.3"

DimPlot(scrna, split.by = "orig.ident", label = T)
DimPlot(scrna, label = T)
# We only collect the PT cells
#CellType[CellType$cluster %in% c("1_1","0", "9","12","18", "19","3"),2] <- "PT" # "Proximal tubule"
levels(Idents(scrna))

#Lymphoidcells <- subset(scrna, subset = Raw_cell_type == "MAC"  )
Lymphoidcells <-
  subset(scrna, subset = RNA_snn_res.0.3 %in% c(3, 7, 8))
Lymphoidcells <- JoinLayers(Lymphoidcells)
# We then recluster the PT cells
# recluster the cells
Lymphoidcells <- SCTransform(Lymphoidcells, verbose = TRUE)
Lymphoidcells <- RunPCA(Lymphoidcells, npcs = 25, verbose = TRUE)

# Run harmony for the PT cells
Lymphoidcells <- RunHarmony(
  Lymphoidcells,
  group.by.vars = c("orig.ident"),
  reduction = "pca",
  assay.use = "SCT",
  reduction.save = "harmony"
)
Lymphoidcells <-
  RunUMAP(
    Lymphoidcells,
    dims = 1:25,
    verbose = TRUE,
    reduction = "harmony"
  )
Lymphoidcells <-
  FindNeighbors(
    Lymphoidcells,
    dims = 1:25,
    verbose = TRUE,
    reduction = "harmony"
  )

Lymphoidcells <-
  FindClusters(Lymphoidcells,  verbose = TRUE, resolution = 1)
# I want to see the layer of Lymphoidcells
DefaultAssay(Lymphoidcells) <- "RNA"
#Lymphoidcells <- JoinLayers(Lymphoidcells)
# Lymphoidcells <- IntegrateLayers(
#   object = Lymphoidcells, method = HarmonyIntegration,
#   orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "harmony",
#   verbose = FALSE
# )
LymphoidcellsDim <- DimPlot(Lymphoidcells, label = T)
LymphoidcellsDim
ggsave(
  filename = "LymphoidcellsDim.pdf",
  plot = LymphoidcellsDim,
  width = 4.5,
  height = 4
)

LymphoidcellsDimSplit <-
  DimPlot(Lymphoidcells, split.by = "orig.ident", label = T)
LymphoidcellsDimSplit
ggsave(
  filename = "LymphoidcellsDimSplit.pdf",
  plot = LymphoidcellsDimSplit,
  width = 10,
  height = 3
)

Idents(Lymphoidcells)
saveRDS(Lymphoidcells, file = "Lymphoidcells.rds")
Lymphoidcells <- readRDS("Lymphoidcells.rds")

```

# 1.2 Attention: we only select the T cell, NK cells, B cells for the further analyses
# Note: the cluster 2, 7, 10, 14, 15 revealed the strong features of the mono-macrophage feature or epithelial doublet (Aqp2)
```{r}
Idents(Lymphoidcells)
Lymphoidcells@meta.data %>% head()
LymphoidcellsF <-
  subset(Lymphoidcells, subset = SCT_snn_res.1 %in% c(0, 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 11, 12, 13, 16))
DimPlot(LymphoidcellsF, label = T)
# Typical mouse lymphoid markers (use combinations, not a single gene):
# T cells / αβ T: Cd3e, Trac, Trbc1/2, Cd4, Cd8a, Cd8b1
# γδ T: Trdc, Trgc1/2
# B cells: Cd19, Ms4a1 (CD20), Cd79a, Ighm, Igha
# NK cells / innate cytotoxic: Ncr1 (NKp46), Klrb1c (NK1.1), Klrk1
# ILCs (incl. ILC2/3): Il7r (CD127), Gata3, Rorc, Il1rl1 (ST2 for ILC2)
# NKT / innate-like: Zbtb16 (PLZF), Klrk1, Cd3e with invariant TCR usage
# markers
lymph_markers <-
  c(
    "Cd3e",
    "Cd4",
    "Cd8a",
    "Cd8b1",
    "Trac",
    "Trdc",
    "Trgc1",
    "Cd19",
    "Ms4a1",
    "Cd79a",
    "Ncr1",
    "Nkg7",
    "Klrb1c",
    "Klrk1",
    "Il7r"
  )
# Find cells expressing Any markers (raw counts in RNA assay)
expr <-
  GetAssayData(LymphoidcellsF, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")  # log-normalized
cells_with_any <-
  colSums(expr[intersect(rownames(expr), lymph_markers),] > 0) > 0
LymphoidcellsUpdated <-
  subset(LymphoidcellsF, cells = colnames(LymphoidcellsF)[cells_with_any])


# LymphoidcellsF <- subset(LymphoidcellsF, subset = Cd3e > 0.1 | Ms4a1 > 0.1|Cd19>0.1 | Nkg7 > 0.1 |Ncr1>0.1 |Il7r>0.1 |Tnfrsf17 >0.1  )
DimPlot(LymphoidcellsUpdated, label = T)
DimPlot(LymphoidcellsUpdated, label = T, split.by = "orig.ident")

DotPlot(LymphoidcellsUpdated, features = lymph_markers)
DotPlot(LymphoidcellsUpdated, features = kidneycellsMarkers) + RotatedAxis()
LymphoidcellsUpdated <-
  SCTransform(LymphoidcellsUpdated, verbose = TRUE)
LymphoidcellsUpdated <-
  RunPCA(LymphoidcellsUpdated, npcs = 15, verbose = TRUE)

# Run harmony for the PT cells
LymphoidcellsUpdated <- RunHarmony(
  LymphoidcellsUpdated,
  group.by.vars = c("orig.ident"),
  reduction = "pca",
  assay.use = "SCT",
  reduction.save = "harmony"
)
LymphoidcellsUpdated <-
  RunUMAP(
    LymphoidcellsUpdated,
    dims = 1:15,
    verbose = TRUE,
    reduction = "harmony"
  )
LymphoidcellsUpdated <-
  FindNeighbors(
    LymphoidcellsUpdated,
    dims = 1:15,
    verbose = TRUE,
    reduction = "harmony"
  )
LymphoidcellsUpdated <-
  FindClusters(LymphoidcellsUpdated,
               verbose = TRUE,
               resolution = 1)

DimPlot(LymphoidcellsUpdated, label = T)
LymphoidcellsDimUpdated <- DimPlot(LymphoidcellsUpdated, label = T)

ggsave(
  filename = "LymphoidcellsDimUpdated.pdf",
  plot = LymphoidcellsDimUpdated,
  width = 4.5,
  height = 4
)

LymphoidcellsDimSplitUpdated <-
  DimPlot(LymphoidcellsUpdated, split.by = "orig.ident", label = T)
LymphoidcellsDimSplitUpdated
ggsave(
  filename = "LymphoidcellsDimSplit_Updated.pdf",
  plot = LymphoidcellsDimSplitUpdated,
  width = 10,
  height = 3
)

```

# 1.3 We noticed Th17 and Treg are enriched in different region of cluster 10
# To further check the Th17 and Treg, we subset the cluster
```{r}
FinalBiomarkerDir <-
  c(
    "/Users/XXW004/Documents/Projects/RuizRosado/PIPseq/Results/Evaluation_V022723/CellEvaluation_Subclustering_V0803/LymphoidCells/Biomarkers/UpdatedBiomarkers_V2/"
  )
setwd(
  "/Users/XXW004/Documents/Projects/RuizRosado/PIPseq/Results/Evaluation_V022723/CellEvaluation_Subclustering_V0803/LymphoidCells/Biomarkers/UpdatedBiomarkers_V2/"
)
# we can seperate the Th17 and Treg
LymphoidcellsUpdated@meta.data %>% head()
sub <-
  subset(LymphoidcellsUpdated, subset = SCT_snn_res.1 %in% c(10))
sub <- FindVariableFeatures(sub)
sub <- ScaleData(sub)
sub <- RunPCA(sub, npcs = 5)
sub <- RunUMAP(sub, dims = 1:5)
sub <- FindNeighbors(sub, dims = 1:5)
sub <-
  FindClusters(sub, resolution = 0.4)  # adjust resolution if needed

DimPlot(sub, label = T)
table(Idents(sub))
DotPlot(sub, features = c("Cd4", "Ifng", "Il2", "Il17f", "Il17a", "Foxp3"))
FeaturePlot(sub, features = c("Cd4", "Ifng", "Il2", "Il17f", "Il17a", "Foxp3"))

# add the subcluster into the meta data
Idents(sub) <- "seurat_clusters"
sub$subcluster <- Idents(sub)
LymphoidcellsUpdated$subcluster <- NA
LymphoidcellsUpdated$subcluster[match(colnames(sub), colnames(LymphoidcellsUpdated))] <-
  sub$subcluster

LymphoidcellsUpdated$combined_cluster <- ifelse(
  is.na(LymphoidcellsUpdated$subcluster),
  as.character(LymphoidcellsUpdated$SCT_snn_res.1),
  paste0(
    LymphoidcellsUpdated$SCT_snn_res.1,
    "_sub",
    LymphoidcellsUpdated$subcluster
  )
)

LymphoidcellsUpdated@meta.data %>% head()
Idents(LymphoidcellsUpdated) <-
  LymphoidcellsUpdated$combined_cluster

# we noticed that cluster 6 mainly enriched with high mitochondrial and rRNA genes.
# Due to the low quality of cluster 6, we need to remove these clusters
LymphoidcellsUpdated@meta.data$SCT_snn_res.1

  subset(LymphoidcellsUpdated, subset = SCT_snn_res.1 %in% c(0:5, 7:12))

  LymphoidcellsUpdatedF@meta.data %>%   mutate(
    FinalLymphoidCellAnnot =
      case_when(
        combined_cluster %in% c("0") ~ "Th1",
        combined_cluster %in% c("1") ~ "B cells",
        combined_cluster %in% c("2") ~ "T-RCM",
        # Tissue-recirculating central memory T cells
        combined_cluster %in% c("3") ~ "cNK cells",
        #NK cells (Cytotoxic)
        combined_cluster %in% c("4") ~ "gamma-delta T-17 cells",
        combined_cluster %in% c("5") ~ "Cd8",
        #combined_cluster %in% c("6") ~ "LQ Cells",
        combined_cluster %in% c("7") ~ "iNK cells",

        combined_cluster %in% c("8") ~ "gamma-delta T-17 cells",

        combined_cluster %in% c("10_sub1") ~ "Th17",

        combined_cluster %in% c("11") ~ "gamma-delta T-17 cells",
```

# ######################################################################################
# 2. Calcuate the number of cell types in different infected date
# ######################################################################################
# 
```{r}
message(">>> Calcuate the number of cell types in different infected date ...")
FinalLymphoidCellNumbers <-
  LymphoidcellsUpdatedF@meta.data %>% dplyr::select(orig.ident, FinalLymphoidCellAnnot) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame()
factor(FinalLymphoidCellNumbers$orig.ident)
# set up the level of orig.ident
FinalLymphoidCellNumbers$orig.ident <-
  ordered (
    factor(FinalLymphoidCellNumbers$orig.ident),
    levels = c("0DPI", "3DPI", "7DPI", "28DPI")
  )

# set up the levels of FinalLymphoidCellAnnot
FinalLymphoidCellNumbers$FinalLymphoidCellAnnot <-
  ordered (factor(FinalLymphoidCellNumbers$FinalLymphoidCellAnnot),
           levels = AnnotationLevels)

# draw the plot of cell number under differnt infected time.
LymphoidCellNumberFigure <-
  ggplot(data = FinalLymphoidCellNumbers, aes(x = FinalLymphoidCellAnnot, y = Freq, fill =
                                                orig.ident)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +  labs(x = "Cell Type", y = "Frequency", fill = "Timepoint") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave(
  "LymphoidCellNumberFigure.pdf",
  plot = LymphoidCellNumberFigure,
  height = 3.5,
  width = 6
)

# generate the proportion of these cells in the immune cells
scrna@meta.data$orig.ident %>% table()
FinalLymphoidCellNumbers %>% head()
FinalLymphoidCellProportion <-
  FinalLymphoidCellNumbers %>% mutate(
    Proprotion = case_when (
      orig.ident == "0DPI" ~ Freq / 566,
      orig.ident == "3DPI" ~ Freq / 1618,
      orig.ident == "7DPI" ~ Freq / 2660,
      orig.ident == "28DPI" ~ Freq / 11902,
    )
  )

LymphoidCellProportionFigure <-
  ggplot(data = FinalLymphoidCellProportion,
         aes(x = FinalLymphoidCellAnnot, y = Proprotion, fill = orig.ident)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +  labs(x = "Cell Type", y = "Frequency", fill = "Timepoint") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave(
  "LymphoidCellProportionFigure.pdf",
  plot = LymphoidCellProportionFigure,
  height = 3.5,
  width = 6
)

# we generated the stacked barplot figure that show the number of each cell type during the infection
LymphoidCellProportionFigureStack <-
  ggplot(data = FinalLymphoidCellProportion, aes(x = orig.ident  , y = Freq, fill =
                                                   FinalLymphoidCellAnnot)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +  labs(x = "Cell Type", y = "Frequency", fill = "Timepoint") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave(
  "LymphoidCellProportionFigure_stack.pdf",
  plot = LymphoidCellProportionFigureStack,
  height = 3.5,
  width = 6
)

```

# Check the functional enrichment of difference among the different cell types
```{r}
message(">>> Detect differentially expressed genes...")
setwd(dir = GOenrichDir)
LymphoidCellTypemarkers <- FindAllMarkers(LymphoidcellsUpdatedF,
                min.pct = 0.25,test.use= "MAST") 
LymphoidCellTypemarkers<-AllClustermarkers
write.csv(LymphoidCellTypemarkers,file = "Lymphoidcells_allclustermarkers_Updated.csv")

# Generate a table for figure
LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneFreqFigure <-
  table(LymphoidCellTypemarkers$cluster) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Var1, y = Freq)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity") + theme_classic() +  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("Lymphoid cell type") + ylab("Differentially expressed gene number")

ggsave(
  "LymphoidBiomarkersnumbersFigure.pdf",
  plot = LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneFreqFigure,
  height = 4,
  width = 6
)

# Create a GO comparison for the figure
LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgene <- list()
LymphoidCellTypes<- levels(Idents(LymphoidcellsUpdatedF))
for (n in LymphoidCellTypes) {
  # put he DEG into the up-regulated gene for comparision
  LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgene[[n]] <-
    LymphoidCellTypemarkers %>% filter(cluster %in% n &
                                        avg_log2FC >= 0.25) %>% pull(gene)
  #}
}
LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgene
#library(clusterProfiler)
# Comparing the Cluster
message(">>> Peform the GO functional enrichment of differentially expressed genes...")
LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneGOenrich <-
  compareCluster(
    geneClusters = LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgene,
    fun = "enrichGO",
    OrgDb = "org.Mm.eg.db",
    ont = "BP",
    keyType = 'SYMBOL',
    pvalueCutoff=1
  )

?compareCluster
write.csv(LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneGOenrich,
          "LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneGOenrich.csv")

LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneGOenrichDotPlot <-
  dotplot(
    LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneGOenrich,
    font.size = 12,
    label_format = 80,
    showCategory = 3
  ) +RotatedAxis()
? dotplot
#low = "LightBlue", midpoint=0, mid="white", high = "FireBrick",
ggsave(
  "LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneGOenrichDotPlot.pdf",
  plot = LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneGOenrichDotPlot,
  height = 18,
  width = 18
)

# we group the description and calcuate by the number

LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneGOenrichCalculation<- LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneGOenrich %>% as.data.frame() %>% group_by(Description) %>% summarise(count=n(), groups = paste(unique(Cluster), collapse = ", "))

write.csv(LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneGOenrichCalculation, file = "LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneGOenrichCalculation.csv")

# we only consider the significance that showed in one cluster
LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneGOenrichCalculationSignifcance<- LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneGOenrich %>%  as.data.frame() %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>% group_by(Description) %>% summarise(count=n(), groups = paste(unique(Cluster), collapse = ", "))
write.csv(LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneGOenrichCalculationSignifcance, file = "LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneGOenrichCalculationSignifcance.csv")
# Identify the pathways only in one
LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneGOenrichCalculation %>% dplyr::filter(count ==1) %>% group_by(groups) 

# Then I would like to integrate these significance and nonsigificance together
FinalLymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneGOenrichCalculation <-LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneGOenrichCalculation %>% left_join(LymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneGOenrichCalculationSignifcance, by= "Description")
write.csv(FinalLymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneGOenrichCalculation, file = "FinalLymphoidClusterSpecifcUpgeneGOenrichCalculation.csv")
```

# ######################################################################################
# 5. Generate the Trajectories of T cells, 
#     identify the UPEC increase genes within these Lymphoid cell types
# ######################################################################################
# 5.1 build the monocle run pipeline, this will use object, root identity, and output prefix, target clusters.
```{r}
run_monocle_increasing_genes <- function(
  seurat_obj,
  target_clusters = c("Th1"),
  root_ident = "0DPI",
  output_prefix = "PT_pseudotime"
){
  library(Seurat)
  library(monocle3)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  library(dplyr)
  
  message(">>> Subsetting target lineage cells...")
  LymphoidTCells <- subset(
    seurat_obj,
    subset = FinalLymphoidCellAnnot %in% target_clusters
  )
  
 
  # Extract counts
  expr_matrix <- GetAssayData(LymphoidTCells, slot = "counts")
  p_data <- LymphoidTCells@meta.data
  f_data <- data.frame(
    gene_short_name = rownames(LymphoidTCells),
    row.names = rownames(LymphoidTCells)
  )
  
  message(">>> Building cell_data_set object...")
  cds <- new_cell_data_set(expr_matrix,
                           cell_metadata = p_data,
                           gene_metadata = f_data)
  
  # Monocle3 pipeline
  message(">>> Preprocessing CDS...")
  cds <- preprocess_cds(cds)
  cds <- reduce_dimension(cds, preprocess_method = "PCA")
  plot_cells(cds, label_groups_by_cluster=FALSE,  color_cells_by = "FinalLymphoidCellAnnot")
  # Use Seurat UMAP
  message(">>> Injecting Seurat UMAP embedding...")
  seurat_umap <- Embeddings(seurat_obj, reduction = "umap")[colnames(cds), ]
  cds@int_colData$reducedDims$UMAP <- seurat_umap
  
  # Clustering
  message(">>> Clustering cells...")
  cds <- cluster_cells(cds)
  
  # Learn graph
  message(">>> Learning trajectory graph...")
  cds <- learn_graph(cds)
  
  # Root cells
  message(">>> Setting root based on ", root_ident, "...")
  root_cells <- colnames(cds)[cds@colData$orig.ident == "3DPI"]
  cds <- order_cells(cds, root_cells = root_cells)
  plot_cells(cds,
           color_cells_by = "FinalLymphoidCellAnnot",
           label_groups_by_cluster=FALSE,
           label_leaves=FALSE,
           label_branch_points=FALSE)
  # Identify genes changing over pseudotime
  message(">>> Running graph_test (spatial autocorrelation)...")
  pr_graph_test <- graph_test(cds, neighbor_graph = "principal_graph")
  
  # generate the trajectory graph
  TrajectoryCellsPlot<- plot_cells(cds,
           color_cells_by = "pseudotime",
           label_groups_by_cluster=FALSE,
           label_leaves=FALSE,
           label_branch_points=FALSE)
   ggsave(filename = paste0(output_prefix,"TrajectoryCellsPlot.pdf") , plot =  TrajectoryCellsPlot, width =8, height = 8)
   
   
  increasing_genes <- subset(
    pr_graph_test, q_value < 0.05 & morans_I > 0
  )
  
  message(">>> Fitting models for increasing genes...")
  fit <- fit_models(
    cds[row.names(increasing_genes), ],
    model_formula_str = "~pseudotime"
  )
  
  coefs <- coefficient_table(fit)
  
  up_genes <- subset(
    coefs,
    term == "pseudotime" &  q_value < 0.05
  )
  
  up_gene_list <- unique(up_genes$gene_short_name)
  message(">>> Found ", length(up_gene_list), " increasing genes.")
  
  # Build matrix for heatmap
  message(">>> Building pseudotime expression matrix...")
  mat <- exprs(cds)[match(up_gene_list, rownames(rowData(cds))),
                    order(pseudotime(cds))]
  
  mat <- t(apply(mat, 1, function(x){ smooth.spline(x, df = 3)$y }))
  mat <- t(apply(mat, 1, function(x){ (x - mean(x)) / sd(x) }))
  rownames(mat) <- up_gene_list
  RequestGeneDotPlot<- VlnPlot(LymphoidTCells, features = up_gene_list,group.by  = "orig.ident")
  
 ggsave(filename = paste0(output_prefix,"VlnPlotSplitByData.pdf") , plot =  RequestGeneDotPlot, width =12, height = 15)
 
 RequestGeneFeaturePlot<- FeaturePlot(seurat_obj, features = up_gene_list,split.by   = "orig.ident")
  
 ggsave(filename = paste0(output_prefix,"FeaturePlotSplitByDateGenes.pdf") , plot =  RequestGeneFeaturePlot, width =30, height = 30)
  # Heatmap km=8
  message(">>> Drawing k-means heatmap km=8...")
  pdf(paste0(output_prefix, "_psudotimeGenes_upregulated.pdf"),
      height = 9, width = 8)
  htkm <- Heatmap(
    mat,
    name = "z-score",
    col = colorRamp2(seq(-2,2,length=11), rev(brewer.pal(11,"Spectral"))),
    show_row_names = TRUE,
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
    km = 8,
    row_title_rot = 0,
    use_raster = TRUE,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE
  )
  print(htkm)
  dev.off()
  
  # Heatmap hierarchical Ward.D2
  message(">>> Drawing hierarchical clustering heatmap...")
  pdf(paste0(output_prefix, "_Hierarchical_upregulated.pdf"),
      height = 9, width = 6)
  hthc <- Heatmap(
    mat,
    name = "z-score",
    col = colorRamp2(seq(-2,2,length=11), rev(brewer.pal(11,"Spectral"))),
    show_row_names = TRUE,
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
    clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
    clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2",
    row_title_rot = 0,
    use_raster = TRUE,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE
  )
  print(hthc)
  dev.off()
  
  # Return results
  message(">>> DONE.")
  return(list(
    cds = cds,
    up_genes = up_gene_list,
    heatmap_matrix = mat
  ))
}
```

```{r}
## Trajactory step 1: choose genes that define a cells' progress that compare the infection vs noninfection within the infected timepoints
# First, we must decide which genes we will use to define a cell's progress through myogenesis. We ultimately want a set of genes that increase (or decrease) in expression as a function of progress through the process we're studying.

#Ideally, we'd like to use as little prior knowledge of the biology of the system under study as possible. We'd like to discover the important ordering genes from the data, rather than relying on literature and textbooks, because that might introduce bias in the ordering. We'll start with one of the simpler ways to do this, but we generally recommend a somewhat more sophisticated approach called "dpFeature".

# One effective way to isolate a set of ordering genes is to simply compare the cells collected at the beginning of the process to those at the end and find the differentially expressed genes, as described above. The command below will find all genes that are differentially expressed in response to the switch from growth medium to differentiation medium:

#           (T0_counts == max(T0_counts))])
# table(CDS@phenoData@data$SCT_snn_res.0.3, CDS@phenoData@data$DataSet)[,"0DPI"]
GM_state <- function(CDS){
  if (length(unique(CDS@phenoData@data$FinalLymphoidCellAnnot)) > 1){
    T0_counts <- table(CDS@phenoData@data$FinalLymphoidCellAnnot, CDS@phenoData@data$orig.ident)[,"0DPI"]
    return(as.numeric(names(T0_counts)[which
          (T0_counts == max(T0_counts))]))
  } else {
    return (1)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Prepare cluster labels and reduced dimensions

sce$FinalLymphoidCellAnnot

# Reduced dimensions

# add the PCA

# Run slingshot

# Extract pseudotime

pseudotime %>% head()

# Visualization

# Identifying temporally dynamic genes
#BiocManager::install("tradeSeq")
library(tradeSeq)

# fit negative binomial GAM
sce <- fitGAM(sce)

saveRDS(sce, file = "T_Cell_Fitnegativebinomial.rds")
# test for dynamic expression
ATres <- associationTest(sce)
# We can then pick out the top genes based on p-values and visualize their expression over developmental time with a heatmap. Here we use the top 250 most dynamically expressed genes
ATres[order(ATres$pvalue), ] %>% head()
topgenes <- rownames(ATres[order(ATres$pvalue), ])[1:30]
pst.ord <- order(sce$slingPseudotime_1, na.last = NA)
heatdata <- assays(sce)$counts[topgenes, pst.ord]
sce@metadata
heatclus <- sce$GMM[pst.ord]
paletteLength = 100 
myColor = colorRampPalette(c("royalblue", "white","lightcoral"))(paletteLength)
library(viridis)
myColor <- viridis(100, option = "B")
pdf("TopTemporallydynamicGenes.pdf", height = 4, width = 4)
pheatmap(as.matrix(heatdata), scale = "row", cluster_cols = F, show_colnames = F,treeheight_row = F,color=myColor,border_color = NA, breaks = seq(-3, 3))
dev.off()
heatmap(log1p(heatdata))
```

```{r}
# Then we recluster these cells

TNKcells <- RunPCA(TNKcells,npcs = 15, verbose = TRUE)

				group.by.vars = c("orig.ident"), 
				reduction = "pca", assay.use = "SCT", reduction.save = "harmony")
TNKcells <- RunUMAP(TNKcells, dims = 1:15, verbose = TRUE, reduction = "harmony")
```

```{r}
Lymphoidcells@meta.data <- Lymphoidcells@meta.data %>%   mutate(MACIntegrateAnnot = 
           case_when(SCT_snn_res.0.05 %in% c("0") ~ "RecMAC", # Recruited MAC
                     SCT_snn_res.0.05 %in% c("1") ~ "ResMAC", # Resident MAC
                     SCT_snn_res.0.05 %in% c("2") ~ "B", # B Cells not the Macrophage
                 )) 
 
 # then add the PTIntegrateAnnot into the meta data of orignal
# generate the data frame for PT cell meta data
MACSubAnnotation <- Lymphoidcells@meta.data %>% dplyr::select(SCT_snn_res.0.05, MACIntegrateAnnot)

table(MACSubAnnotation$MACIntegrateAnnot)

scrna@meta.data
## add this annotation into the meta dataset
scrna@meta.data <- scrna@meta.data %>% rownames_to_column('CellID') %>% 
  left_join( MACSubAnnotation %>% rownames_to_column('CellID'))%>% 
# then add a new column that change the NA into Raw_cell_type
  # mutate(NewAnnoation = coalesce(PTIntegrateAnnot,Raw_cell_type))
  mutate(MACSub = ifelse(is.na(MACIntegrateAnnot), Raw_cell_type,MACIntegrateAnnot))
### join the meta data to meta annoation

Idents(scrna) <- scrna@meta.data$MACSub

scrna@meta.data %>% head()

row.names(scrna@meta.data) <- scrna@meta.data$CellID
 DimPlot(scrna, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5)
```

# generate the health cluster of Myeloblast cells
Ref: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-023-40156-6
```{r}
MYEDir <- c("/Users/XXW004/Documents/Projects/RuizRosado/PIPseq/Results/Evaluation_V022723/CellEvaluation_Subclustering_V0803/MYE_Subclusters/")
setwd(MYEDir)
# Read the preclustered object

# We only collect the PT cells
#CellType[CellType$cluster %in% c("1_1","0", "9","12","18", "19","3"),2] <- "PT" # "Proximal tubule"

scrna @meta.data

#Lymphoidcells <- subset(scrna, subset = Raw_cell_type == "MAC"  )
Lymphoidcells <- subset(scrna, subset = Raw_cell_type == "MAC" |Raw_cell_type == "NEU" |Raw_cell_type == "B" )
Lymphoidcells@meta.data

# We then recluster the PT cells
# recluster the cells
Lymphoidcells <- SCTransform(Lymphoidcells, verbose = TRUE)
Lymphoidcells <- RunPCA(Lymphoidcells,npcs = 8, verbose = TRUE)

# Run harmony for the PT cells
Lymphoidcells <- RunHarmony(Lymphoidcells, 
				group.by.vars = c("DataSet"), 
				reduction = "pca", assay.use = "SCT", reduction.save = "harmony")
Lymphoidcells <- RunUMAP(Lymphoidcells, dims = 1:8, verbose = TRUE, reduction = "harmony")
Lymphoidcells <- FindNeighbors(Lymphoidcells, dims = 1:8,  verbose = TRUE, reduction = "harmony")

Lymphoidcells<- FindClusters(Lymphoidcells,  verbose = TRUE, resolution = 0.1)

LymphoidcellsDim<- DimPlot(Lymphoidcells,label = T)
LymphoidcellsDim
ggsave(filename = "LymphoidcellsDim.pdf", plot = LymphoidcellsDim, width = 8, height = 6)

LymphoidcellsDimSplit<-DimPlot(Lymphoidcells, split.by = "DataSet",label = T)
LymphoidcellsDimSplit
ggsave(filename = "LymphoidcellsDimDimSplit.pdf", plot = LymphoidcellsDimSplit, width = 10, height = 3)

Idents(Lymphoidcells)
```

# generate the subclusters of PT, DCT, IC, PC
```{r}
# dividing into cycling, transitioning, adap- tive (successful or maladaptive repair) and degenerative (damaged or stressed). 
# cycling: Mki67
# Early Injury: Cdh13, Cdh6, Havcr1
# Late Injury: Ccl2, Gm17268, Cald1
# conserved: Slc13a1, Slc5a2,  Slc7a13, Cyp7b1



# Panoptosis
# Il1b, MLKL, Gsdmd,Ripk3

# Fibrosis 
# Fn1, Col1a1, Col3a1, Tgfb1
# adaptive
# VCAM1, DCDC2 and HAVCR1, C3, ICAM1
# VCAM1 PROM1 ITGB8
# Vcam1, Havcr1, Dcdc2, Icam1, Prom1, ITgb8

#degenerative
# SPP1, CST3, CLU and IGFBP7, APOE ALDOB
# B2M S100A6
# Spp1, Cst3, GDF15,Clu, Igfbp7, Apoe, Aldob, B2m, S100a6
# agionegious PEC,
# EGFR, VEGF, Cdh5

# Egfr, Vegf, Cdh5
KidneyStatuesMarkers<- c("Slc13a1", "Slc5a2", "Slc7a13", "Cyp7b1","Mki67","Cdh13", "Cdh6", "Havcr1","Ccl2", "Gm17268", "Cald1")

KidneyStatuesTypeMarkers<- c("Il1b", "Mlkl", "Gsdmd","Ripk3","Fn1", "Col1a1", "Col3a1", "Tgfb1","Vcam1", "Havcr1", "Icam1", "Prom1", "Spp1", "Cst3","Gdf15", "Clu", "Igfbp7", "Apoe", "Aldob", "B2m", "S100a6")

DotPlot(scrna, features =  KidneyStatuesMarkers, col.min = -0.5) +RotatedAxis()
DotPlot(scrna, features =  KidneyStatuesTypeMarkers, col.min = -0.5) +RotatedAxis()


for (i in KidneyStatuesMarkers){
# 
  FeaturePlots<-FeaturePlot(scrna, features =  i, split.by = "DataSet" ) +RotatedAxis()
  ggsave(paste0(Outdir,"/KidneyStatuesMarkers/", i, "_Feature_GeneMarkers_Annoatation.pdf"), plot =FeaturePlots, height =6, width = 14)
}

for (i in KidneyStatuesTypeMarkers){
# 
  FeaturePlots<-FeaturePlot(scrna, features =  i, split.by = "DataSet" ) +RotatedAxis()
  ggsave(paste0(Outdir,"/KidneyStatuesTypeMarkers/", i, "_Feature_GeneMarkers_Annoatation.pdf"), plot =FeaturePlots, height =6, width = 14)
}
```
